Range-bound 154-164 for 4 weeks on falling volume. Drift is probably over. Stop trailed to about 153.3, under the 11/20 and 11/25 lows (153.91, 154.47), and I plan to close at the 12/2 horizon unless it breaks 164 on volume.

Post-earnings gap held for 7 sessions, 11/25 closed at 146.09 near the 147.44 high on a retail read-across. Stop trailed to about 139, under the 11/24 low of 139.20 and above the gap-base zone. Target raised to about 156 to let the drift run. Price/volume only.

Brazil-wide pre-market surge (NU +11.7%, ITUB +17.7%, XP +19.5%, EWZ +14.3% on 14% of an average day), cause unknown. Brazilian banks fell 20% on 10/26 (probably the election result) and drifted down for 4 weeks, so this is a relief or regime re-rating. NU is a $60B eligible proxy with 0.1% slippage. Small test of continuation, price/volume only.

summary:
Session 2026-11-27 (half day). SPY +1.7% pre-market and QQQ +2.3%, a tech/AI bounce (SNDK +10%, MRVL +6%) after the crash. Defensives are flat to down, so SNY is -2.9% pre-market at 52.83 (stop 50.42, kept). VRTX is -8% pre-market on after-hours news. I skipped it as an unknown-cause short (rule 3).

New finding: a Brazil-wide pre-market surge. ITUB +17.7%, BBD +23.5%, XP +19.5%, NU +11.7%, PBR +11.5%, VALE +8.3%, EWZ +14.3% on 14% of an average day. ITUB had fallen 20% on 137M shares on 10/26 (probably the election result) and then drifted down for 4 weeks. The cause is unknown. ITUB is not eligible (not a common stock or ADR) and BBD is under $5, so I bought NU at 5% (stop 9%, target 18%, 8-day horizon, p=0.52) as a small test of whether a country-wide relief gap continues.

Trailed stops under the post-gap lows with extend: GKOS ~242 (target +8.5%), PDD ~83.3 (target +9%), DKS ~147.3 (target +10%), CROX ~153.3 (horizon 12/2, close unless it breaks 164 on volume), TJX ~139 (target +7%). SNY is unchanged.

Skipped: HPQ (+11.5% on 11/25, inside its range), PHAR (+16.7% pre-market after -24%, $0.7B, illiquid), AMBA, the semis bounce, and tech longs.

Next session (Monday 11/30): check whether NU held above its 11/25 close of 12.36 and whether the Brazil gap held. If it faded on day 1, exit and treat country-wide gaps as not worth chasing. Check SNY against the 50.4 stop. Check CROX against the 12/2 horizon. Look for new real-cap gaps on 3x+ volume with 10%+ of an average day pre-market. Cash is about 56% after NU.
feedback: No news access made the Brazil-wide surge impossible to verify. I could not tell whether it was a political event, a policy change or a short squeeze, so I sized it as a small test. The first submission was rejected because ITUB is 'not a common stock or ADR' even though scan did not flag it. Showing eligibility in scan output would save a round trip. A country or region tag in the scan output, or a digest line for group moves ("N ADRs from the same country moved more than 8%"), would help. The pre-market list is dominated by thin prints under 5% of an average day, so a minimum-volume filter would make it more useful.
